about_the_game:
Who is Thelma Fantastic?

Octogenarian, 12 grandkids, 2 husbands (both deceased), president of the local knitting club, and possibly the worlds greatest detective.

Find Suspect's Missing Objects

Suspects are not keen to help unless you help them first. Find a few objects and learn the truths that make solving a case easy. 

Solve Puzzles

Take the clues and apply logic and intuition to become a skilled detective and crack the cases. The sudden rise in crime can't be a coincidence can it? 

Work for a Legend and Maybe Become One Yourself

Test yourself against Thelma Fantastic in the casual and timed modes featuring randomly generated hidden object scenes with random characters, items, and placement. 

Unlimited replay-ability.

Expected Features:

  • Featuring hidden object levels, and logic puzzles, and a mysterious shadow over the city

  • Unique characters to help and learn about. 

  • Hundreds of animated objects to find and explore.

  • Prebuilt and randomized levels. 

  • A casual mode for replay-ability

  • A timed mode to challenge yourself

content_descriptors.notes: It's a murder mystery game so it features the idea of murder.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating System
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GT 430 (1024MB)/Radeon HD 5570 (1024 MB)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: A hidden object mystery game. Help Thelma Fantastic find missing objects, discovery important clues, and solve mysteries. Plus a custom mode for unlimited hidden object level generation.
